subject.title: Improve doctor/gateway diagnostics clarity for mixed LaunchAgent/runtime states

question: Should doctor grow a consolidated final gateway diagnosis model that combines RPC health, service runtime/config drift, and channel conflict hints, and should that model expose a machine-readable diagnosis block?
rationale: Current main already collects many underlying facts, but the public state taxonomy, precedence, action ordering, and JSON shape are stable CLI/gateway UX choices that automation should not invent without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add a composed doctor verdict
options.body: Render one healthy/degraded/down diagnosis with probable causes and ordered recovery steps while reusing existing doctor, service, runtime, and channel facts.

options.title: Refine individual panels only
options.body: Keep current independent doctor panels and improve only the misleading message cases proven by a live mixed-state transcript.

options.title: Design structured diagnosis first
options.body: Define a compact diagnosis object before rendering prose and optional JSON output from it in a later implementation.

recommendation.title: Add a composed doctor verdict
recommendation.body: Render one healthy/degraded/down diagnosis with probable causes and ordered recovery steps while reusing existing doctor, service, runtime, and channel facts.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is recent work on gateway probe and doctor diagnostics plus repeated adjacent commits in the relevant doctor/gateway path.
